permanence_buffer.quote: accordance with the VCS permanence risk assessment tool, 13% of the estimated net change in the project’s carbon stocks (baseline stocks minus stocks in the project case) will be set aside in a risk buffer account and not sold (cf. section 3.5 and annex 5).

crediting_period.value: thirty years, stretching from January st st 1 2005 to December 31 2034
crediting_period.quote: The VCS project crediting period for the Makira project will be of thirty years, stretching from January st st 1 2005 to December 31 2034.

estimated_reductions.quote: The implementation of the project will generate an estimated 38,016,930 tons of CO2 equivalents in emission reductions (t CO2-e) over the 30-year crediting period (cf. table 1).

conflicts.quote: This corresponds to annual emissions reductions of 1,267,231 tons of CO2 equivalent per year and the Makira project can therefore be considered as a VCS mega project (more than 1,000,000 t CO2-e/y emission reductions).

additionality.value: Tool for the Demonstration and Assessment of Additionality in VCS Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use (AFOLU) Project Activities
additionality.quote: The project applied the steps outlined in the VCS Tool, VT0001, “Tool for the Demonstration and Assessment of Additionality in VCS Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use (AFOLU) Project Activities” to demonstrate the additionality of the project.

area.quote: The project covers an area of 370,032 hectares.

conflicts.quote: and estimates it will remove and/or reduce 10,119,729 tCO2e over the course of the first 10 years of the validated baseline.

additionality.value: VT0001 Tool for the Demonstration and Assessment of Additionality in Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use (AFOLU) project activities
additionality.quote: Additionality is demonstrated following the Verified Carbon Standards (VCS) tool ‘VT0001 Tool for the Demonstration and Assessment of Additionality in Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use (AFOLU) project activities’ which applies a stepwise approach.
